manifesto.label: 04 · OUR MANIFESTO
manifesto.title: Faced with an obsolete system that judges the past, we are building a future where recruitment is finally based on potential, humanity and intelligence.
manifesto.p1: The current system is in crisis. It fails everyone. Companies are flooded with mismatched profiles while candidates, judged on a résumé that doesn’t reflect their true potential, are treated as an interchangeable resource. This paradox costs billions and breeds immense frustration. We refuse this status quo.
manifesto.p2: Hiry was built on a simple conviction: recruitment shouldn’t be a selection based on the past, but an encounter based on future potential. By replacing keywords with a deep understanding of skills, culture and aspirations, we create authentic connections.
manifesto.mission: 1 Mission · Make recruitment fairer and more human

rights.label: YOUR RIGHTS
rights.title: Your rights with AI
rights.intro: An AI plays a part in your recruitment: you have the right to know what it does, and what it doesn’t. The EU AI Act classifies recruitment as a high-risk use, and Hiry is built to meet it.

c1.lead: No decision is made by a machine.
c1.text: Hiry assesses and ranks, a human decides — always. You can ask why you were turned down: every decision is traced, with who made it.

c2.text: Hiron assesses your skills and the motivations you state. It says nothing about your voice, your face or your state of mind — the regulation forbids it, and above all it has no scientific basis.

c3.text: You know when an AI is involved, you can access your data, and you can delete it.

faq.label: 05 · FAQ
faq.title: Your questions? Our answers.
faq.a1: A solution that matches you with internships, apprenticeships and first jobs using AI. Hiron understands your potential through a conversation (not just your résumé) and only shows you compatible openings, with a transparent score.
faq.a2: Job boards make you search and apply into the void. Here it’s the opposite: openings come to you, and for every match we explain why you’re compatible: culture, soft skills, values. Apply less, apply better.
faq.a3: Every company is profiled just like you: management, atmosphere, values, ways of working. Matching crosses its DNA with your aspirations: you know what you’re signing up for before first contact.
faq.a4: Nothing, forever. Companies pay to access the talent pool.
faq.a5: You can import it to speed up your profile, Hiron transforms it. But it’s no longer the judge: your potential, soft skills and aspirations count as much as your track record.
faq.q6: Does an AI decide for me?
faq.a6: No. Hiry assesses your profile and ranks applications, which affects the order recruiters see them in. But no status is ever changed by a machine: every decision comes from a person, and it’s traced with who made it. You can ask why you were turned down.
faq.q7: Why does Hiry ask whether I’m still looking?
faq.a7: So companies don’t contact you for nothing. We ask every two months, or a month before your contract ends if you told us when. If you don’t answer, nothing changes. If you’re not looking or have found something, you leave the searches: your matches are hidden, not deleted, and come back if you do.
faq.a8: Companies Hiry introduces you to because your profile matches their needs, and the ones whose talent pool you joined. To leave the first, say you’re not looking or have found something. For the second, leave their talent pool whenever you like.

faq.label: 05 · FAQ
faq.title: You have questions? We have answers.
faq.q1: How many job posts can I publish?
faq.a1: As many as you like. They stay online as long as your subscription is active.
faq.a2: No. The subscription starts as soon as you sign up, and you can post right away.
faq.a3: Monthly has no commitment: €89 excl. VAT per month, cancel anytime. Yearly comes to €75 excl. VAT per month, billed monthly, with a 12-month commitment.
faq.q4: What if I cancel the yearly plan mid-year?
faq.a4: Cancellation takes effect at the end of the 12-month commitment; until then, the subscription stays active and keeps being billed. If you don’t cancel, it renews for 12 months.
faq.a5: In two clicks from your billing area. Your job posts, applications and conversations are kept.
faq.q6: I’m a partner of a school or a job fair. Do I need to subscribe?
faq.a6: No: job posts reserved for your school or job fair remain free.
faq.q7: Will I have to re-enter all my job posts?
faq.a7: No. Give us the address of your careers page or of a job post, and we’ll import it for you — one at a time, or all at once.
faq.q8: What happens if I stop paying?
faq.a8: Nothing is deleted. After seven days without payment, your job posts go offline, and you’re notified beforehand. Your applications, conversations and notes stay available, and your posts come back online as soon as you resume your subscription.
faq.a9: A standing need, with no date and no applications: Hiry continuously shows you the profiles that match it. The subscription includes two.
faq.a10: Hiry is hosted in Europe (Google Cloud, europe-west region) and GDPR compliant.

c1.title: Your Career Center? A directory.

c2.title: Traditional method = maximum friction

c3.title: The hidden market stays… hidden
c3.desc: Micro-businesses, SMBs, startups: they make up 99% of companies but never appear on your platforms. Your students miss thousands of opportunities.

c4.title: Zero visibility on what’s really happening

vision.label: 04 · OUR VISION FOR SCHOOLS
vision.title: Career placement shouldn’t be an afterthought. We are building a smart bridge between your students and the professional world.
vision.p1: Every student you train deserves support all the way to their first job. The problem isn’t a lack of talent or a lack of openings, it’s the absence of a tool that intelligently connects the two. Traditional Career Centers are static directories nobody uses, and placement data arrives too late to act.

faq.label: 05 · FAQ
faq.title: Your questions? Our answers.
faq.q1: What type of institution can use Hiry?
faq.a1: Business schools, engineering schools, universities, specialized schools, apprentice training centers: as soon as you have cohorts to place (internship, apprenticeship, first job), the control tower adapts to your tracks and programs.
faq.q2: How long to get up and running?
faq.a2: About ten minutes to create your space, 2 minutes to invite a cohort. No IT project, no complex integration: our team supports you for an express start.
faq.q3: How are students matched with companies?
faq.a3: Each student creates an enriched profile with Hiron, our AI: soft skills, aspirations and potential beyond the résumé. Matching then automatically connects each profile to compatible openings from your network and the Hiry pool, with a transparent score.
faq.q4: How does Hiry detect struggling students?
faq.a4: The dashboard monitors weak signals: engagement drop, inactivity, matches with no follow-up. The AI predicts placement risk per profile and proactively alerts you, so you can act before it’s too late.
faq.q5: Can we export data for our accreditations?
faq.a5: Yes: placement funnel, benchmark by cohort and program, event outcomes: everything exports as presentation-ready reports for your accreditations, rankings and boards.
faq.q6: What does it cost the school?
faq.a6: Custom quote, based on cohort size and desired support level. The solution remains free of charge for your students, in all cases.

about.label: 04 · ABOUT · OFFICIAL TEXT
about.boiler: Hiry is a French AI-powered recruitment solution positioned as “zero friction”. Its agent, Hiron, builds a 360° profile of every candidate (data, résumé, 10-minute voice interview) and an employer profile on the company side, then performs predictive matching with a compatibility score. Hiry serves candidates, companies and schools.
